topic: Basic needs and interdependence of living things
key_concepts: All living things have basic needs that must be met by their environment.
Basic needs include water, sunlight, food, and shelter.
Wants are different from needs and basic needs.
An environment is everything around a living thing and includes living and nonliving thing

Water is both a nonliving thing and a basic need.
Plants and animals depend on each other to survive.
Animals need plants for food, and plants may need animals for pollination.
Living things also depend on nonliving things in the environment to survive.
